body: character reference sheet T-POSE, arms outstretched horizontally like an airplane / scarecrow -- a chibi voxel-block toy figure of a hooded mage with BOTH ARMS RAISED STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height (NOT down at the hips, elbows fully straight, each arm forming a straight horizontal line from the shoulder), both blocky hands open with fingers spread, nothing held, a big visible gap of empty background between each hand and the torso. Taller and thinner blocky proportions than a knight but still made of assembled rectangular blocks (voxel-art collectible figure), every part a flat rectangular block with hard 90-degree edges, NO smooth curves, NO soft gradient shading -- each block face a single FLAT solid color with a bold thick black outline stroke around every edge like a toy render. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart, nothing overlapping the torso or limbs. Matte dark navy-charcoal blocky robe with thick gold trim blocks down the front, a blocky pointed hood block shadowing the face with a flat glowing cyan-teal visor rectangle for eyes, a small gold chest gem block, blocky boots. Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, full body visible head to feet, no text, no logos
